$comment: VAPP-110 Exponential apps ×4 (web routes/t/$teamSlug/apps/*, desktop crates/ui apps screens, iOS Apps/*, Android ui/apps/*). An APP = a team-scoped declarative package (the Exponential UI SDK's format: manifest + A2UI templates + bindings + a function allowlist, data never code) rendered by the Exponential UI renderers through the client's app host (`exp:` bindings over the synced store, `harness.*` functions behind the consent card, the URL policy). ONE look ×4. THE LIST (`apps` view, nav entry `copy.nav` between Threads and Devices, the IDE rail alike; the phones' third tab): a Section band `copy.title` with `copy.newApp` as its trailing action pill, then ListRows = BoardGlyph (icon + colour, the board set) + name (medium) + the version pill `copy.version` (`v{n}`; `copy.noVersion` = the DRAFT badge, muted, while head_version = 0) + a trailing `…` menu (`copy.menu.*`: Export, Delete → the confirm prompt `copy.deleteTitle`/`copy.deleteBody`, members may delete only their own apps, owners every app; no Rename: the agent names an app, the settings page renames it). Exponential ships NO built-in apps (2026-10-24): the list is the team's synced apps only. Rows sort by name (case-insensitive). Empty (a team with no apps): the list-size EmptyState `copy.empty` under the band. NEW APP (VAPP-176, EDITOR-FIRST, no dialog, no form, no `/settings/apps/new`): EVERY New app entry (the list pill, the sidebar group's `+`, the IDE rail's `+`, the settings nav's `@new-app`) calls tRPC `apps.create {teamId}` with NO other field = a DRAFT named `copy.untitled` (slug `slugify(copy.untitled)` de-duplicated with `-2`, `-3`; no icon, no colour; head_version 0) and opens its editor at once. A DRAFT = an app with no version yet (head_version 0); its version pill reads `copy.noVersion` (`Draft`). THE AGENT NAMES IT: a draft's editor brief tells the editor session to pass name, icon, colour and description on its first `apps upsert`; a rename while the app is still a draft (that upsert, or the settings page) RE-DERIVES the slug from the new name (`slugify`, the app's own slug not counted as taken), so every editor keys the app by ID and follows a slug change in place (web: the route is replaced). CLEANUP: leaving the editor of an EMPTY draft (no version and no editor session, i.e. nothing was ever sent) calls tRPC `apps.discardDraft {id}`, which hard-deletes it only when it is still empty and the caller created it (anything else = a no-op), so abandoned drafts never pile up. IMPORT (app-export.json) sits on the list band as a second pill `copy.import` before New app. THE EDITOR (`app` view, route `/t/$teamSlug/apps/$appSlug`, VAPP-177 `editorTabs`): header = BoardGlyph + name + the version pill; on web ≥ md and desktop the header ends in a SegmentedControl of `editorTabs.wide` (VAPP-178 adds Data: Preview | Data | Versions | Settings; phones Chat | Preview | Data; the DATA tab = app-records.json `dataTab`) (`copy.tabs.*`, testId `tabs`) and the BODY = two panes, the chat `panes.chat` : the TAB pane `panes.preview` (fr), a hairline between (the chat pane has no header strip of its own); the editor opens on `editorTabs.default` (no tab is kept), a deep link `?tab=<id>` (web) or the settings nav (desktop) opens that tab. Phones (and web < md): a SegmentedControl of `editorTabs.phone` under the header, ONE pane (opens on `editorTabs.phoneDefault`), and the header's trailing `…` menu (testId `menu`) = `editorTabs.menu` (`copy.menu.*`): Versions (the count as trailing meta) and Settings open THE SAME tab bodies as a sheet titled by the item, Export (head > 0 only) the export sheet, Delete app (destructive; the creator or an owner) the delete confirm prompt; a phone deep link to `versions`/`settings` opens that sheet over the Chat tab. A DRAFT's editor: the two panes as always on web ≥ md and desktop, the Chat tab on phones; while its chat is empty the chat pane shows the page-size EmptyState (`copy.starterTitle`, the app glyph) whose actions are one `mode: action` Pill per `copy.starters` entry (a tap SENDS that text as the first message, disabled like the composer without a device), the composer is FOCUSED and its placeholder is `copy.draftPlaceholder`; the preview pane = the page-size EmptyState `copy.previewEmpty`. CHAT = the member's EDITOR SESSION with the app (a root with `sessions.app_id` + `user_id` = me): the same channel rows as a team agent's conversation (ChannelMessageRow: avatar / the app glyph, name, time, body; cards answer in place) and THE composer (`copy.composerPlaceholder`); no session yet = the same pane, empty, whose composer's first send is `sessions.send({appId, text, deviceId})` (the device = the caller's default device, `launch-device`; none online = the composer disabled with `copy.noDevice`). `copy.chatEmpty` sits in the empty chat. LIFETIME: entering the editor starts nothing; leaving it (route change, tab close) ENDS the member's live editor session (`sessions.end` on the root: the tree); the next send revives the same root (FEED-134: the row goes idle again with its context, so the chat is that root's messages). PREVIEW = the app host rendering the HEAD package's first template (`applyTemplate`, surface id = the slug) in a frame `preview.radius` px / `preview.padding` px with the theme's background; the apps shape carries the head package, so every MCP `apps upsert` repaints it live. No version yet: the page-size EmptyState `copy.previewEmpty` in the frame. The HostBanner (offline / catalog update) sits above the surface; the consent card is the client's. VERSIONS (VAPP-177: the `versions` TAB on web ≥ md and desktop, the menu's sheet on phones; none yet = the list-size EmptyState `copy.versionsEmpty`): ONE grouped list (testId `versions`), rows newest first = the `copy.version` pill (`v{n}`) + `note` (`copy.noNote` muted when empty) over a muted caption `who · relative time` (a person's name, or `copy.byAgent`); trailing: the head row = the `copy.head` badge, every other row = a `copy.preview` ghost button (testId `versionPreview`) + a `copy.restore` outline button (testId `versionRestore`). PREVIEW switches to the Preview tab (phones: closes the sheet, the Preview tab) showing that version: a banner `copy.viewing` with `copy.restore` and `copy.head` (back to the head) above the surface; RESTORE (the row's button or the banner's) = tRPC `apps.restore` → a NEW head version `copy.restoredNote` (`Restored v{n}`), toast `copy.restored`, the preview back on the head. CAPS: contract `apps` (slug, name, description, note, package bytes, components per template). RECORDS (VAPP-122, fixtures/app-records.json): an app keeps its own data as records (`records: {<kind>: {schema}}` in the manifest; `exp:records?kind=…` reads them live, `harness.records.upsert/delete` write them, no consent card); the editor's SETTINGS tab (×4, VAPP-177) shows the count as one muted line under the description: `recordsCountLabel` (`copy.records*`: `1,240 records`, with the plan quota `1,240 of 25,000 records`, `No records`); the quota (plan-limits `appRecords`, cloud only) refuses a write with the plan-limit error, shown as a toast. TOOLS (VAPP-120, fixtures/app-actions.json): every MCP operation is a typed host function `exponential.<noun>.<op>`; the editor's SETTINGS tab (×4) shows a `copy.tools` group under the records line: `copy.tools.title` with `copy.tools.hint`, one ListRow per function the head package declares (the display title + the function name muted + a Switch = the grant, a team OWNER only, disabled for everyone else; a destructive action shows `copy.tools.always` in place of the switch: it can never be granted), `copy.tools.none` when it declares none; `apps.granted_tools` syncs on the apps shape; a switch writes the whole list WITH the head version on screen (`apps.update {grantedTools, headVersion}`, VAPP-156): a head published meanwhile refuses with CONFLICT (the failed-action toast), the row resyncs and the owner grants again; a granted call runs without the consent card, an ungranted or destructive one asks with the operation's words. FEEDBACK: a failed create/delete/restore = toast (feedback-states.json); an invalid name inline. Model = pure `apps.ts` (TS reference): every mirror replays `slugifyCases`, `versionLabelCases` and `sortAppsCases`. DESKTOP NAV (web ≥ md + the IDE rail): no plain Apps nav row; an APPS sidebar GROUP drawn exactly like Agents and Boards, between them: the label `copy.title`, a `+` group action = New app (a draft, its editor), one compact row per app (its glyph in its colour + name → the editor), the hover gear (the creator or an owner) → the app's editor on its Settings tab. The compact rail shows the app icons after the agent icons. SETTINGS mirrors Agents: an `Apps` settings group listing the apps + `copy.newApp` (= New app: a draft, its editor), the index page = the Apps band whose rows open the app's EDITOR on its Settings tab. THE SETTINGS TAB (VAPP-177, testId `settings`; the old `/t/$teamSlug/settings/apps/$appId` page REDIRECTS (replace) to the editor's `?tab=settings`): the identity row (icon + colour + name, the name a deferred write), the description card (saved on blur), the records line, the Tools group (the grant switches, an owner only), then a row with `copy.menu.export` (head > 0) and `copy.menu.delete` (destructive, at the end; the creator or an owner) → the delete prompt, which leaves for the Apps list; at most `editorTabs.settingsMaxWidth` px wide on web ≥ md and desktop. Everyone else sees it read-only. Phones get it (grants included) as the menu's Settings sheet. (VAPP-176: no create mode). PHONES: the Apps LIST is the APPS TAB (chats.json `shell.tabs`, #EXP-1379), a top-level page under the shared page header (`copy.title`, search + inbox circles); its `copy.newApp` pill stays on the Section band. VAPP-129's FLOATING layout (the chat in THE Dock over the preview, its per-device `exp.apps.editorLayout`, Move to the side / Minimize) is GONE since VAPP-177: the chat is always docked beside the tabs.

mediaPolicy.$comment: VAPP-157 (the 2026-10-28 ruling) THE APP HOSTS' MEDIA RULE ×4: an Exponential app's Image / Avatar / Video / Audio src and markdown image loads ONLY when it is (a) a `data:` url whose mime is image/*, audio/* or video/* except image/svg+xml (scheme and mime case-insensitive), or (b) the instance's own attachment, `/api/attachments/<uuid>` relative or absolute on the instance's exact origin (scheme, host case-insensitive, port), the RAW path exactly that (no dot segments, no percent-encoding, no trailing segment), no query, no fragment, no credentials, no surrounding whitespace. Anything else loads nothing (the SDK's existing denied-src rendering: no request, no new UI), so bound team data can never ride a url to another host. The web, desktop, iOS and Android app hosts narrow the SDK's media policy with it (`appMediaAllowed(src, origin)`; a host narrows, never widens); the SDK's own generic default and the link policy are unchanged. `cases` replay ×4 against `origin`.
